title: WPMS/1791/2019 of ASHOK KUMAR BENIWAL Vs HARIDWAR AND ROORKEE DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY

paras.text:
WPMS No. 1791 of 2019
Hon'ble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.
 Mr. Parikshit Saini, Advocate present for
the petitioner.
 Mr. S.S. Chauhan, Advocate present for
the respondent.
 The petitioner has admittedly raised
unauthorized constructions in a development
area. Subsequently, notices were given to the
petitioner for demolition of constructions by his
own, which he did not comply with and now
demolition order dated 13.06.2019 has been
passed by the development authority. Against
the demolition order dated 13.06.2019, the
petitioner has filed a statutory appeal before the
Commissioner, Garhwal Division.
 According to the petitioner, the statutory
appeal filed by the petitioner is still pending
before the Commissioner, Garhwal Division,
whereas the date fixed for demolition of the
constructions raised by the petitioner is
22.06.2019.
 In view thereof, it is directed that the
Commissioner, Garhwal Division shall hear the
appeal of the petitioner on 24.06.2019, or a
nearest possible date and pass appropriate
orders.
 Writ petition stands disposed.
 Let a certified copy of this order be issued
today itself on payment of usual charges.
 (Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.)
 21.06.2019
Avneet/
